title: Render tap line, contract render-tap/1 (spec/feature/render-tap-contract.md)
description: One JSON line a renderer frame tap emits: a frame (what was submitted for drawing) or the end of the stream. A raw tap line is NOT a player observation: the receiver selects player-visible draws by the rules of the contract (pass, visibility evidence, alpha, clip, identifiability) before anything reaches an Observation frame.

seq.description: Tap output counter: +1 for every frame the tap produced, emitted or dropped. A gap = frames lost to backpressure.

matrix4.description: 4x4 matrix, column-major (element 12..14 = translation), right-handed, Y up, world units of manifest coordinates.unit.

rect.description: [x, y, width, height] in viewport pixels, origin top-left, y down.

end.description: Why the stream ends. A stream that closes without an end line is a disconnect.

tick.description: Game tick this frame shows, when the game tells the renderer; never decreases.

t.description: Game clock (seconds) of the frame; never decreases. Not wall time.

id.description: Whose eyes: the camera the frame is rendered for (player-camera for the player view).

visibility_lag_frames.description: How many frames old the occlusion evidence is (query results read without a GPU stall). 0 when exact.

kind.description: Only scene and ui can show something to the observer; the other kinds are kept for diagnosis and never become observations.

dropped.description: Draws the tap could not record in this frame (backpressure): the frame is incomplete and absent instances are unknown, not gone.

identity.description: How mesh / material were named: asset-name (stable asset ID), content-hash (hash of vertex/index/texture contents), count-hash (vertex + index counts only: collides, never identifies).

generation.description: Bumped whenever the renderer reuses the instance handle for another object.

depth_order.description: Submission order within the pass after sorting (0 = first drawn).

visibility.description: Evidence the draw reached the observer's screen: occlusion-passed / occlusion-failed (occlusion query), frustum-only (inside the frustum, occlusion unknown), unknown.

alpha.description: Final opacity of the draw (material x instance). Absent = 1.

ui.description: UI semantics of a ui-pass draw.
